## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- Claims 1–4 are adequately grounded; claims 5–6 are elementary and correct, though claim 5 lacks its one-line proof.
- The proposed next step duplicates accepted task 16’s exact integral presentation of \(Q\), contrary to the accepted-task restriction.
- The draft does not explain why the accepted presentation and coefficient-ring reduction from tasks 16 and 8 fail to yield the desired rank/Smith argument.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Starting from the accepted integral presentation of \(Q\), identify the precise remaining unproved rank or Smith-normal-form statement, and either prove it or exhibit a rigorous obstruction; do not request reconstruction of the already accepted presentation.
